name: Principal registry
purpose: Names the narrow interface the auth flow uses to ask 'is this address registered?' and specifies that the answer is a boolean and nothing else. Principal roles, quotas, tenancy, and identity metadata are project concerns layered above this interface, not inside it.
responsibilities: Declare the isRegistered(email) method as the sole auth-facing surface and boolean as the sole returned type (AC-3111-1).
Ship one single-address registry implementation that reads one email from configuration and returns true only for that email (AC-3111-3).

Guarantee, at the interface level, that the response to a submission is uniform across true and false answers because the boolean never surfaces in the response body, status, or Content-Type (AC-3111-2).
internalStructure: One JSDoc-typed interface declaration in the contract file and one single-address-implementation module. Multi-principal registries (allow-list file, database lookup, external identity provider) are project-authored modules that satisfy the interface.

interfaces.name: isRegistered
interfaces.description: isRegistered(email) -> Promise<boolean>; the sole method the auth code calls on the registry.

tradeoffs: Narrowing the answer to a boolean forbids the registry from returning richer information about the principal on the sign-in path; that is deliberate, because richer information on the sign-in path is exactly what makes an enumeration oracle. Projects that need identity metadata for authorisation load it after session issue, keyed by the principal id from the session record.
